section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a study examining the relationship between exposure to body-focused versus non-body-focused others and body appreciation. At the between-persons level, greater exposure to non-body-focused others positively predicted body appreciation, while exposure to body-focused others negatively predicted it at a trend level. Within-persons analyses showed that daily deviations in exposure to non-body-focused others positively predicted body appreciation, but no significant bidirectional effects were found.
